D2.fit_reasoning: seat 52.15 +/-0.15 is never under the 52.00 ring, so the ring always meets each seat at its crown, along the screws; tightening closes 0.15 and leaves 0.8 - (0.15 +/-0.15) +/-0.30 = 0.2 to 1.1 mm at the split, so the screws always clamp the ring and never plastic on plastic; 0.1 mm axial clearance each side lets the halves close across the bearing

hand_screw_load_n.note: +Y: 300 N / 4. +X: first hand value assumed a cosine pressure shared by both halves; the study shows the ring seated in the lower half at -30 to -1 degrees and wedged under the upper at about 77 degrees: statics with those angles gives 75.7 N tension and 17.5 N shear in total

D2.how_bodies_were_held: lower half: face Y -32 fixed. Upper half: bonded to the four steel screws (head on the counterbore floor), the screws bonded in the insert holes of the lower half. Ring: a soft plug (0.2 MPa, 2 mm thick) bonded in its bore with the plug's dia 6 hub hole fixed; the plug carried 0.124 N of 300 along Y and 0.150 N of 300 along X

contact_proof.method: 1 N in the working direction (the ring has clearance all round, so no reversal): it must cross the 0.075 mm clearance as a rigid body, out of proportion to the load

D2.governing: shear in the lower half, case X300: 2.22 MPa at [24.59, -9.75, -0.07]

print_orientation.upper: flat, face Z -4 on the bed, layers stacked along Z (the bearing axis)

D2.why: reaction equals load on every mesh (299.87 + 0.12 N, 299.85 + 0.15 N); every body is held without the contact; the plug carries 0.04 to 0.06 %; 1 N moves the ring 0.077 mm across its 0.075 mm clearance where a bond would move it 0.0005 mm; the four screw sections carry 298.3 of 300 N; bodies split by geometry; two supports agree outside 2 mm of the held faces. Valid for a snug pair with NO preload: tightening is a separate, larger load, treated by scaling only

verdict.shear_between_layers: met, 5.8, converged on the last step (3 %)
verdict.tension_across_layers: not shown by the playbook rule: 17.8 at the finest mesh but still moving 19 % (1.26 MPa at the edge of a bonded insert)

screw_torque_limit.basis: the +Y case scaled: upper half reaches a factor of 2.0 at 1,440 N through the ring; not solved
